description: This PANGAEA research deposit contains 71 climate-extreme indices calculated from daily GLDAS version 2 temperature and precipitation. The global product has quarter-degree cells and covers 1970–2016. The producer used the ClimPACT2 software and definitions from international climate-index expert teams. Heating and cooling degree days are excluded because they are published separately for different temperature thresholds. The PANGAEA repository provides a tabular landing record linking the data files, with free reuse under CC BY 4.0. A change between GLDAS subversions can introduce breaks near 2010–2011, so the series needs particular care in trend analysis. These indices can describe heat, cold and precipitation hazards for infrastructure-exposure scenarios. They are related to GLDAS climate inputs, but no direct catalogue entry for this derived index collection was identified.
name: A High-Resolution (0.25 degree) Historical Global Gridded Dataset of Climate Extreme Indices (1970-2016) using GLDAS data
